column1: # Station golden (Ruling 214 control 4.2). Columns: n, i, bits of double.CosPi(i/(double)n) as measured on macOS arm64 .NET 10.
# Argument sets in use: i/128 (default span stations), k/4 (default chord), i/8, i/100, i/200 (panel half counts and span variants).
# The bits column is a pin on the runtime: a row that differs on the PC means the cosine kernel is copied into Core (Ruling 156 (2)).
